cd /tmp/obench-cell-xoj9mko6/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_vcgc0tfv && .venv/bin/python -W ignore convert_masks.py mobile_sam.pt out demo_rgb.png demo_metadata.csv 2>&1 | tail -1 && .venv/bin/python -W ignore -c "
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
d=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv');o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png');H,W=im.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int);vis=im.copy()
for i,r in d.iterrows():
  xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int);ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
  m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);p=np.stack([xs,ys],1);cv2.fillPoly(m,[p],1)
  n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m);cnt+=m
  rect=len(set(zip(xs,ys)))<=4
  if n!=2 or rect: print('bad',i,n,rect)
  ox=np.array(o.coords_x[i].split(','),int);oy=np.array(o.coords_y[i].split(','),int)
  cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([ox,oy],1)],True,(255,0,0) if o.type[i]=='rectangle' else (0,0,255),1)
  cv2.polylines(vis,[p],True,(0,255,0),1)
print('overlap px:',(cnt>1).sum())
cv2.imwrite('vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
"
